open_threads: THE CAST'S OWN CORRECTION, and it is the firing worth reading: the /intent packet hung the tooth on the PROVED EXIT GATE. The /sorted completeness gate bit — A VOYAGE THAT KICKS BACK NEVER CROSSES PROVED, and a kick-back is the CHARACTERISTIC end state for a voyage that answered a discovery inline. one-owner-for-the-instance-address is the existence proof, sitting at [BUILDME:waiting] carrying both edits. Corrected to ride the crossing out of BUILDME in either direction. PRIOR ART RESHAPED THE NODE TWICE: I-prebuild-cognition-compiles step 8 already states the contract (PROPOSED 2026-07-19, never enforced), and the RE-ENTRY MECHANISM is already physics — the back-edge grammar in base's chokepoint, crossed by this very voyage. Only the tooth that notices a discovery which never took it is absent. Law 4's tracked-debt state exactly. THE TOOTH'S DECLARED WEAKNESS, said out loud rather than buried: it is DOWNSTREAM of the claim. It catches a false build-time claim that produced an EDIT and is blind to one that produced nothing — so the head -20 is caught only through its consequences, and a silent run is NOT evidence that no build-time claim was made. Also: the substring test is generous by choice, so its noise is strong evidence and its silence is weak; and the added-vs-modified premise is n=1. THREE SIBLINGS NAMED IN THE TICKET, ALL OWED CASTS: a decompose piece's file list is prose no gate checks against the survey berth; a build-time CLAIM about the world is an absence needing a measure (the head -20 itself, which this tooth cannot see); and cairn.machines.chart.verdict has exactly one exit, so a kick-back is refusable but not berthable. Plus the two children the instance-address ticket still owes (nothing-spells-an-instance-path-by-hand; the-inference-overlay-is-off-the-ladder, to be re-cast as a two-ruling disagreement).
